name: get_basket
description: Get the current customer basket and calculated total.

name: add_to_basket
description: Add an item only when the customer requests it; return the updated basket.

product_id.description: Exact product_id from the shared catalogue.

quantity.description: Units to add; non-repeatable products allow one.

name: update_basket
description: Set quantity of an existing basket item; zero removes it.

product_id.description: Exact product_id from the shared catalogue.

quantity.description: New total quantity; zero removes the item.

name: remove_from_basket
description: Remove an item requested by the customer.

product_id.description: Exact product_id from the shared catalogue.

name: prepare_checkout
description: Prepare final summary; show it and ask for customer confirmation. Does not place an order.

name: get_order
description: Retrieve an existing simulated order belonging to the current customer.
